name: loodi-one
description: Shell Capacitor pour l'écosystème Loodi — conteneur unifié de modules PWA

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @loodi/one
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @loodi/bridge && npm run build -w @loodi/ui
scripts.cap:sync:android-emulator: npm run build:android-emulator && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:android-device: npm run build:android-device && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios-simulator: npm run build:ios-simulator && npx cap sync ios
scripts.watch:packages: npm run watch -w @loodi/bridge & npm run watch -w @loodi/ui
